name: self_description_v1
note: The survey's first-person self-description, as the ten legacy runs were built from it. Sentences are alternatives in priority order: the employment/income block degrades to whichever answer the respondent gave, and a nevím answer drops its sentence. Filters carry the grammar - years, in, have - and datasets/sod/describe.py supplies them. Reproduces create_respondent_description exactly over the frozen values; changing any wording here means a new variant file, not an edit.
sentences: Žiji {region|in}, v okresu {district} a obci o velikosti {town_size}.
Z hlediska zaměstnání jsem {employment_status} a příjem naší domácnosti je {income_range}.
